messages.body_plain:
Hi,

It seems the error is being thrown at this step in correctReadDepth

 targetIR <- RangedData(ranges = IRanges(start = targetedSequence[, 2],
                        end = targetedSequence[, 3]), space = targetedSequence[, 1])

Can you make sure that the exons data frame is well-formed and that it has 3 columns?
ncol(exons) # should give 3

Also, make sure that you are using the UCSC chromosome naming convention because you have "chr" in the chromosome.
genomeStyle="UCSC"

Please let me know if this helps.

Best,
Gavin

messages.subject_clean: correctReads.R with Whole exome sequencing data
messages.body_plain:
correctReads.R, as it is without modification, will not work with exome data because the correctReadDepth function call does not use the targetedSequence argument.  You will need to modify it as you have done in your original post.

What version of TitanCNA are you using?
If you would like to debug your particular wig files and exon targets, you can access the code https://github.com/gavinha/TitanCNA/blob/master/R/utils.R under function
correctReadDepth <- function(tumWig, normWig, gcWig, mapWig, genomeStyle = "NCBI", targetedSequence = NULL){ ... }

You can directly source this function and use the R debugging feature or simply go through each line of code in this function until you encounter the error.

Hope this helps.

Best,
Gavin
